PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- The page is numbered 3 at the top right.
- The document section is titled "Artemis Campaign".
- Refers to Exploration Systems Development Mission Directorate (ESDMD).
- Refers to Artemis I's flight heat shield anomaly.
- Refers to NASA policy and protocol under NPR 7120.5.
- Mentions capability upgrades and programs: Orion Crew Capsule, Space Launch Systems Block 1B Exploration Upper Stage and Associated Capabilities, Gateway Program initial capability, Human Landing System (HLS) initial capability, and Mobile Launcher 2 (ML2).
- Mentions prime contractor Bechtel National, Inc. (Bechtel) regarding ML2.
- Contains two footnotes regarding the Gateway capability and NPR 7120.5 paragraph 2.4.1.6.
